items.quote: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens
items.claim: The text says that once Moses was grown, he went out to his brethren and saw their burdens.
items.action: went out unto and looked on the burdens of

items.quote: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
items.claim: The text says Moses saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, whom it calls one of Moses's own brethren.
items.object: an Hebrew, one of Moses's brethren
